message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as the cover of Tempo magazine, featuring a stylized depiction of an aircraft cockpit in a monochromatic red and black palette. The large word "TEMPO" is centered at the top in a red, serif font. Below it, a dark overhead panel is filled with numerous small, glowing red switches, dials, and indicator lights. A central black pillar divides the view out of two large, blank red windows. 

Across the center, bold white text reads "KOKPIT BUTA JT 610." Smaller white text underneath provides details about a flight system. The lower half of the image displays the main instrument panel, densely packed with illuminated red gauges, buttons, and digital displays. At the bottom left, a white box contains a barcode, the number "00037," and pricing information including "5-11 NOVEMBER 2018," "RP 45.000," and "WWW.TEMPO.CO." At the very top, two headlines in white text flank a diagonal line: "JEJAK SUAP PETINGGI PARTAI AMANAT NASIONAL" and "TERKATUNG-KATUNG KONSUMEN MEIKARTA."
